import sys


def main():
    rows = []
    for line in sys.stdin:
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        cells = [cell.strip() for cell in line.split("|")]
        rows.append(cells)

    if not rows:
        return

    # Determine column widths
    widths = [max(len(cell) for cell in column) for column in zip(*rows)]

    # Determine if each column is numeric
    is_numeric = [all(cell.replace('.', '', 1).isdigit() for cell in column[1:] if cell) for column in zip(*rows)]

    def fmt(row, widths, is_numeric):
        cells = []
        for cell, width, numeric in zip(row, widths, is_numeric):
            if numeric and cell:
                # Pad numeric columns on the left
                cells.append(cell.rjust(width))
            else:
                # Pad other columns on the right
                cells.append(cell.ljust(width))
        return " | ".join(cells)

    # Print header
    header = fmt(rows[0], widths, is_numeric)
    print(header)

    # Print separator
    separator = "-+-".join("-" * w for w in widths)
    print(separator)

    # Print data rows
    for row in rows[1:]:
        print(fmt(row, widths, is_numeric))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
